text:
Maria: Heads-up — customers keep saving route-level views and then wondering why quota/cost preview shows defaults instead of the model they pinned. UX confusion + support tickets.
Kevin: Do we have a repro? is it that saved view doesn't persist the model_pin metadata?
Maria: Yep. Saved view payload only stores filters + route id. No model pin, no per-model sample rate. Example from UI: `POST /api/saved_views {route: 'search.pay', filters: [...], name: 'slow-search-week'}`
Lex: We intentionally separated view vs model binding to avoid coupling, but that tradeoff seems to be biting the console.
Dave: If we add model binding to saved views we need an API contract for v2. Backwards compatibility concerns.
Sara: Could we surface a lightweight hint in the UI without changing the backend? e.g., show "No model pinned — using routed model" badge and a small cost delta tooltip.
Kevin: I like lightweight hint, but support still needs a way to snapshot exact runtime config. Saved views should be able to capture an explicit model override.
Maria: Proposal: keep saved view schema unchanged for now, but add optional `bindings: {model: "<model-id>", sample_rate: "0.1"}` in v2. UI stores hints locally for v1 and shows a migration CTA.
Lex: Question: how do rollouts interact? If a saved view pins an exact model version we should define fallback policy (e.g., if model missing -> nearest compatible or use route default).
Dave: Define fallback in API: `fallback: "route-default" | "latest-compatible" | "reject"`. Default to `route-default` for safety. Document clearly.
Sara: UX: show a tiny badge on saved view tiles — if binding exists show model name + version, else show "uses route default". On hover show quota preview for the pinned model vs route default.
Kevin: Dev note: backend change requires migration script to keep existing saves intact. Also add admin flag to allow disabling model-pinning for teams with strict governance.
Maria: Agree. Timeline idea: quick UI hint in next sprint (no backend change). Then API v2 for bindings + fallback and migration in 2 sprints.
OpsBot: deploy-bot: New branch pushed: feature/savedview-model-hints — CI passed. PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/834
Lex: I'll draft the API shape and fallback matrix today. Will post swagger snippet here.
Maria: Thanks — once Lex posts API sketch, Kevin can estimate infra work and Dave can review auth surface. :thumbsup:
